# Legacy tone profile source

Source: https://github.com/yomiplush/youtube-cassette-filter

Pinned revision: `1f0150146b574b89386abeddb90e68d5fa12532d`

Copyright (c) 2026 YomiPlush. MIT license retained in `LICENSE` and served as `public/licenses/LEGACY-FILTER-MIT.txt`.

The Light/Medium/Heavy high-pass, low-pass and saturation targets inform the optional tone profiles in `src/audio.js`. The current player's independent noise generation, subtle modulation, transport and CC0 mechanical recordings remain in use. This is not an unmodified port of the extension. No audio recordings were found or copied from that repository, and no YouTube media is included. See `docs/research/legacy-filter.md` for parameters and differences.
